environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed in a Kubernetes pod with a custom init container that establishes a pivot_root(2) jail before the JVM starts. The pod spec uses a distroless base image with an overlayfs mount consisting only of: /app/config (3 YAML files), /app/scripts/maintenance.sh (read-only, contains only echo statements), /app/results (writable tmpfs, 10MB limit, noexec), /tmp (writable tmpfs, noexec), and the JRE runtime files. The container runs with a seccomp profile that blocks pivot_root, mount, umount2, ptrace, and unshare syscalls post-initialization. The pod's SecurityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, and drops ALL capabilities. A Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS and a specific internal service CIDR. The Istio sidecar enforces mTLS and strips all X-* headers from external traffic, replacing X-User-Role with the value from the JWT claim 'role' validated against the OIDC provider. There is no /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd (beyond nss_wrapper minimal), /proc (hidePid=2 with masked paths), or any credential material within the chroot boundary.

config.runtime: Kubernetes pod with distroless base, pivot_root jail
config.header_handling: Istio sidecar strips X-* headers from external requests; X-User-Role derived from validated JWT 'role' claim
config.network_policy: Egress restricted to cluster DNS (UDP/53) and 10.96.0.0/16
